definitions.gloss: day duty; person on duty for the day; daily monitor
definitions.explanation: A rotating responsibility assigned to a person for a particular day. In Japanese schools, the 日直 leads class greetings, writes the date on the board, and handles various classroom tasks. In workplaces, it refers to the person covering duties on a given day, such as holidays or weekends.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{日直|にっちょく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧？
examples.english: Who is on day duty today?

examples.japanese: {日直|にっちょく}⟦{当番|とうばん}→当番：04564_touban⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{黒板|こくばん}→黒板：02756_kokuban⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{消|け}した→消す：00528_kesu⟧。
examples.english: Since I was on day duty, I erased the blackboard.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小学校|しょうがっこう}→小学校：01055_shougakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧、{日直|にっちょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「{起立|きりつ}、⟦{礼|れい}→礼：02170_rei⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{号令|ごうれい}→号令：11960_gourei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{緊張|きんちょう}した→緊張する：20557_kinchousuru⟧。
examples.english: When I was in elementary school, I used to get nervous giving the "Stand up, bow" commands on my day duty days.

notes:
USAGE:
{日直|にっちょく} is a familiar concept in Japanese school life. Students take turns serving as {日直|にっちょく}, performing tasks such as leading the greeting at the start and end of class, filling in the daily log, and cleaning the blackboard. In workplaces, {日直|にっちょく} refers to someone on call or covering the office on a day when most staff are absent.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日直|にっちょく}⟦{当番|とうばん}→当番：04564_touban⟧ (day duty shift)
- {日直|にっちょく}⟦{日誌|にっし}→日誌：23512_nisshi⟧ (day duty log)
- {日直|にっちょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧ (day duty tasks)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {日直|にっちょく}: day duty (rotated daily)
- ⟦{当番|とうばん}→当番：04564_touban⟧: duty, person on duty (general term)
- {週番|しゅうばん}: weekly duty (rotated weekly)
- {宿直|しゅくちょく}: overnight duty (staying at the workplace overnight)
